name: Kogarashi Inn
description: Kogarashi Inn is a block theme for a small country inn. The home page opens in two halves: a misty ground with the title and three parenthesised status fields above, a full-bleed breakfast photograph below, and an analogue house clock whose hands follow local time sitting on the seam. It continues with a dark parallax band of one-sentence lines, notes from the house with a dashed closing rule, the day as eight time-stamped lines, a photograph bleeding off the left edge with the rooms, one long dinner table, a bath-house parallax band, seven people as two columns of name rows beside a photograph bleeding off the right edge on a dark ground, and the rates with the four booking fields. Cormorant Garamond for headings, Newsreader for reading, Noto Serif TC and JP for Chinese and Japanese. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; fade-up and parallax only, off for reduced motion.
